title: 第12章  猪崽和老面
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦淮茹没待多久，就被李阳用自行车驮到了公路边上。

班车一来，她就拎着那五斤棒子面，上车回城了。

李阳心里头敞亮。

说句实心话，他惦记秦淮茹不是一天两天了。在四合院里，他压根儿寻不着下手的空子。几年熬下来，他都快死了这条心了，哪晓得机会说来就来，半点不由人。

“这娘们儿真不愧是院里一枝花，确实够味儿。”李阳暗地里咂摸着滋味儿。

昨儿个他差点没把秦淮茹揉碎了嵌进骨头里去，翻来覆去地折腾，浑身上下都舒坦透了。

“往后也不至于猴急猴急的了，心里想了，寻个由头找她就是了，嘿嘿。”李阳嘴里嘟囔着，贼笑了两声。

啥事都是头一回难，开了这道门，往后啥路子都有了。

“就是得防着她吸咱的血。荤腥能沾，亏可不能吃。回了院儿里，该装穷还得装穷。”李阳心里头拿定了主意。

这年头，有油水得藏着掖着，不能摆到桌面上来。李阳不是那号咋咋呼呼的脾性，也没兴趣跟人显摆逞能，更膈应被人盯上。

所以打从一分配进那座四合院，摸清了里头住着一院子牛鬼蛇神之后，他就打定了主意——跟这帮人搅和到一块儿去，谁也甭嫌谁。

大伙儿都穷，都爱拿人情压人。你压我，我也压你，来来回回，谁也别想落下风。

街坊邻里的，手头紧了借点钱粮不是天经地义？又不是赖着不还。

说起来也怪，李阳隔三差五就这么干，偏生没人戳他脊梁骨，反倒落了个好名声。

都知道他爹妈走得早，家里没个老人掌舵，底子薄。上了班又养成个手松的毛病，有钱就散，改也改不过来。大伙儿除了可怜他，也愿意搭把手。

当然了，要紧的是李阳这人讲信用，有借有还。当月还不上，顶多拖个两三个月，多少会还上一截。中间跟人打了招呼，还会拿些零碎东西当利息。

要不这样，早就人人喊打了。

从公路边折回来，李阳没急着往家赶，脚下一拐去了邻村。打算顺路把周木匠那套木匠家什买回来。

家伙什搬回家，已经是晌午了。

路过生产队长田老蔫家门口，李阳叫人给喊住了。

“李阳你来得正好，有桩好事寻你。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Huairu didn't stay long before Li Yang carried him to the side of the road on a bicycle.

As soon as the shuttle bus came, she took the five kilograms of stick noodles and got on the bus back to the city.

Li Yang's heart was bright.

To be honest, he had been thinking about Qin Huairu for more than a day or two.In the courtyard, he couldn't find any opening to start.After a few years, he was almost giving up on this idea. He didn't know that opportunities would come at any time, and he had no control over them.

"This girl is truly worthy of being a flower in the courtyard, she is really delicious." Li Yang secretly tasted the taste.

Yesterday, he almost crushed Qin Huairu into pieces and embedded it into his bones. He tossed and turned around, and his whole body felt comfortable.

"I won't be so impatient in the future. I thought to myself, just find a reason to find her, hehe." Li Yang muttered and laughed twice.

Everything is difficult the first time. If you open this door, you will have all the options in the future.

"We just have to prevent her from sucking our blood. You can get the blood, but you can't eat the bad things. When you get back to the courtyard, you have to pretend to be poor when you should." Li Yang made up his mind.

These days, you have to keep things under wraps and not put them on the table.Li Yang doesn't have the temperament to make noises, and he has no interest in showing off his talents to others, and he doesn't deserve to be stared at.

So from the moment he was assigned to the courtyard house and found out that there were a lot of ghosts and monsters living in it, he made up his mind - get involved with this group of people, and no one would be dissatisfied with anyone.

Everyone is poor and loves to take advantage of others.You press me, I press you, back and forth, no one can fall behind.

Isn't it natural for neighbors to borrow some money and food when money is tight?It’s not like I’m just refusing to pay it back.

It's strange to say that Li Yang does this every once in a while, but no one pokes his spine, but he gets a good reputation.

Everyone knows that his parents passed away early, and there is no old man at the helm, so his foundation is weak.When I went to work, I developed a habit of being loose-handed. I would loose my grip when I had money, and I couldn't change it.In addition to pitying him, everyone was willing to lend a hand.

Of course, the important thing is that Li Yang is a man of credit and always pays back what he borrows.If you don't pay it in the current month, it will take two or three months at most, and you will be able to pay back some of the money.I greeted people in the middle and even took some odds and ends as interest.

Otherwise, everyone would have shouted and beaten him.

Turning back from the highway, Li Yang was not in a hurry to go home, but turned to the neighboring village.I plan to buy Carpenter Zhou’s carpenter’s furniture along the way.

It was already noon when the guy moved home.

Passing by the door of production team leader Tian Laowen's house, Li Yang called someone to stop him.

"Li Yang, you came at the right time. I have something good for you."
